final_message:
Built a retention task, the erasure-function change, and two policies (`RET-002`, `ERASE-001`); the dry run passes, nothing pushed, confidence low. Built: task `purge_expired_customer_data`; changed `delete_user_account` (now also deletes support tickets and is tagged `erasure`); tags on `users`, `user_address`, `sessions`, `support_tickets` and `webhook_deliveries`.

The plan in `out/reply.md` said to anonymise orders' `user_id` on account deletion, but I dropped that. Both `db.bulk.patch` forms I tried failed to parse, so orders keep the link to the deleted user. The 2-year purge also covers only support tickets and webhook deliveries, not customer, invoice or payment tables, because those may need longer accounting retention. That's the customer's call. `out/reply.md` and `out/notes.json` have the full details.
